note: Plain '#%' equals the interest_rate tag in all 543 rows, so it is the all-in rate. In '#% (incl. #% PIK)' n1 matches interest_rate and n2 matches pik_rate. The '#% PIK' cells match pik_rate, e.g. 12.69% PIK on SOFR+8.25%, so the whole rate is PIK; I labelled it pik_rate_pct, though it is arguably the all-in rate as well.
